correctness.rationale: Expanding the source PMF gives a cubic polynomial in the count, so its strict survival necessarily uses the cubic geometric tail sum. Direct summation yields the corrected linear coefficient \(\widetilde\omega_1\). The corrected survival satisfies \(S(x-1)-S(x)=p_x\) identically, while the printed formula has a nonzero exact residual. The packaged checker verifies the tail sums, the hazard counterexample, and the stress-strength discrepancy from the actual packaged formulas.

value.rationale: Survival, CDF, hazard, and stress-strength reliability are core advertised properties of the proposed count model. The wrong coefficient can make the printed hazard exceed one, so this is not a cosmetic algebraic typo. The correction supplies an exact replacement coefficient, restores the defining PMF-tail recurrence, and quantifies a downstream reliability error while preserving the separate log-concavity/IFR result.
